dct_description_sm:
Polygons of the garbage collection routes in the County of Grande Prairie serviced by Prairie Disposal. Layer created by Cassandra Chabot, GIS summer student May 2012 based on descriptions of the routes on Prairie Disposal website.

The data in this layer can be freely distributed and used.
